title: Wi-Fi uses: station, access point, local services, and internet

questions.prompt: Which option states the main idea of “Wi-Fi uses: station, access point, local services, and internet” correctly?
options: An ESP32 can use Wi-Fi to join a network or create its own network.
A device on a local network is not automatically reachable from the internet.
For first-time setup, a device can create a Wi-Fi network and a local control page that a phone can open without internet.
An ESP32 can join a router in STA mode to fetch information from a service or send sensor readings to it.
questions.answer: An ESP32 can use Wi-Fi to join a network or create its own network.
questions.explanation: An ESP32 can use Wi-Fi to join a network or create its own network.

questions.prompt: Which additional fact about “Wi-Fi uses: station, access point, local services, and internet” is accurate?
options: This lesson shows how a sensor can publish to a cloud broker and protect that connection.
The ESP32 starts a SoftAP, `WebServer` answers local HTTP requests, and `DNSServer` maps names on that network to the board's IP so a setup page is easy to reach.
These roles enable configuration, data collection, and local or internet-connected services.
questions.answer: These roles enable configuration, data collection, and local or internet-connected services.
questions.explanation: These roles enable configuration, data collection, and local or internet-connected services.

questions.prompt: Which practical detail should be considered when using “Wi-Fi uses: station, access point, local services, and internet”?
options: In STA mode the device joins a router
STA (station) joins a router or phone hotspot and can reach the internet.
This is a starting point for a captive portal
questions.answer: STA (station) joins a router or phone hotspot and can reach the internet.
questions.explanation: STA (station) joins a router or phone hotspot and can reach the internet.

questions.prompt: Which statement from the “Wi-Fi uses: station, access point, local services, and internet” lesson is correct?
